summary: Control case: complete, consistent, already-contained escape of water. Policy and address match the register; invoice matches date, address and description; no safety issue. Correct handling: notify Greyfriars with the facts and the invoice, confirm to Aisha with next steps, no cover promise, no escalation, no unnecessary questions.
required_outcomes: Notifies Greyfriars Mutual of the claim for GMH-30417 with the key facts: date/time (8 Oct ~7pm), cause (split basin hose), containment (stopcock, Brook Plumbing replaced hose), damage (bathroom vinyl, stained but dry kitchen ceiling), and attaches/forwards Brook invoice BP-1092 £145.
Confirms to Aisha that the claim has been notified, that Greyfriars will register it and may ask for photos, and that this is not a decision on cover.
Does not escalate to a human or hold the case for unnecessary information.
acceptable_alternatives: Ask Aisha to upload photos to Greyfriars when requested, or mention photos are available in the notification.
positive_behaviours: Mentions the £250 escape-of-water excess neutrally (from the register) or that an excess may apply.
Advises keeping the split hose and not starting permanent repairs to vinyl/ceiling until Greyfriars confirms.
red_flags: Escalates to a human for no reason.
Asks for information already provided (address, date, policy number, invoice).
prohibited_actions: Promising the claim will be paid or how much.
critical_failures: Fails to notify the insurer (takes no action).
